rule: A canon gap is surfaced, never invented around. An implementer blocked by one stops the affected work item and takes it to the named canon owner or an ADR.

The Hypervisor-to-ioi.ai crossing has no contract. Canon defines rich outbound handoffs FROM ioi.ai (IoiAiGoalChatHandoff into Hypervisor App/Web, Automations, Foundry, wallet.network, aiagent.xyz, sas.xyz, provider/restore flows) but names no object for the reverse direction: moving work from an existing Hypervisor context into an admitted ioi.ai GoalRun. The reconciliation brief requires that crossing to be an explicit, reviewable, idempotent, receipt-backed handoff with owner admission, and states that a pointer, UI link, correlation identifier, MCP call, subscription, or facilitator selection is not admission. No envelope, no route, and no receipt family carries it today, so nothing prevents a future implementation from treating a correlation id as the crossing. GoalRun admission itself is sound (it requires goal_ref, a real target_session_ref and project_ref, scope:goal.run.orchestrate, receipts, and a state-root ref), so the gap is the missing crossing object, not weak admission. Canon owner to resolve: docs/architecture/domains/ioi-ai/control-plane.md with docs/architecture/domains/ioi-ai/collaborative-outcome-pattern.md and docs/architecture/foundations/objects/goal-pursuit.md.
